test_mechanism.adapter: fake adapter (executor-neutral in-memory FakePlanAuthorityAdapter implementing PlanAuthorityMutationPort + readback)
test_mechanism.authority: fixture authority (disposable raw document bodies with deterministic revisions/digests; no production Issue writes)
test_mechanism.store: disposable local store (in-memory TransactionStore + journal table; no production DB)
test_mechanism.controller: controllable fault-injection adapter with deterministic hooks

injection_points.expected: FAILED_NO_EFFECT; no external attempt allowed; classification J9
PREPARED → FAILED_NO_EFFECT (no APPLYING means no attempt); retry only with fresh preconditions

injection_points.fault: external adapter returns known definitive rejection (stale raw revision, invalid successor, protected target)
injection_points.expected: APPLYING → FAILED_NO_EFFECT with rejection evidence + unchanged observed raw

injection_points.fault: external adapter times out / drops connection
injection_points.expected: APPLYING → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; mandatory reconciliation before retry

injection_points.fault: authority store definitively rejects mutation with proven no effect (authorization denied, predecessor invalid)
injection_points.expected: APPLYING → FAILED_NO_EFFECT; influx of RETRYABLE only after fresh auth

injection_points.fault: transport returns no status; process killed before response is durably classified
injection_points.expected: Stranded APPLYING → RECONCILING on restart; three-way comparison

injection_points.fault: process crash after external success but before verify readback is durably persisted
injection_points.expected: Future run reconciles nonterminal APPLYING/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN via authority read → VERIFIED_RECOVERED if candidate observed (J3/J10)
Remain OUTCOME_UNKNOWN or RECONCILING; no blind retry; surface failure deterministically; next run retries read

injection_points.fault: restart during RECONCILING after one read
injection_points.expected: Idempotent re-entry: re-read observed, re-classify per precedence; duplicate reconciliation does not duplicate external effect

adapter_hooks.during_verify_read: inject read error | return candidate | return original | return third
adapter_hooks.during_terminal_persist: inject failure to drive J10 path

determinism: Do not depend on random network failures; all faults are deterministically triggered via fake adapter hooks and fixture revision/digest control
external_mutation_test_isolation: All construction/review tests use fake/fixture boundaries; production GitHub and production authority store are never written during planning or source acceptance
